videos.script: Most stream code is the same few operations, in different orders. This lesson goes through them on the shelf from lesson 6. {{steps}} filter keeps, map transforms, and flatMap turns one element into several, which is how a list of books becomes a list of the words in their titles. {{reduce}} Then reduce, the operation that folds a whole stream into one value. Total price of the shelf, in cents, starting from zero. {{rule}} reduce has one rule that the compiler cannot check: the way you combine must not care how the values are grouped. Break it, and the answer depends on how the work was split. {{collect}} And last, collect, which builds a container instead of a single value. It is where lesson 8 starts.
